WITH ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_sales 
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE))
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
    GROUP BY s_store_id
), csr AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales 
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE))
    JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_id 
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
), wsr AS (
    SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_sales 
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE))
    JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk 
    GROUP BY web_site_id
), salesreturns AS (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || s_store_id AS id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss FROM wsr
)
SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit 
FROM (
    SELECT channel, id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss 
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT channel, id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss 
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT channel, id, sales_price, return_amt, profit, net_loss 
    FROM wsr
) x 
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
